sources.title: Seed2.1 official model page
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The overview explicitly describes Pro and Turbo as two models in different sizes. Exact Turbo columns in knowledge, reasoning, image and video tables give benchmark scores, not total or activated parameters. No publicly sized base or same-weights serving-tier relationship is stated.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Officially Released: Advancing AI Productivity
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The June 23 announcement describes model development and agent improvements but supplies no nominal total or active count, nor a named publicly sized base relationship for Turbo.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Model Card: Agentic Intelligence for Productivity
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the complete 73-page text from the same-day official-PDF cache at /tmp/model130-reaudit/seed21.txt on October 27. Read the introduction, exact Turbo comparison rows and all parameter/base/distillation matches. The card distinguishes Turbo and Pro; tables contain benchmark scores, not activated-parameter columns. Parameter and distillation matches concern worked coding/agent examples, not a production size or structural lineage.

sources.title: ModelArk quick start
sources.evidence: Official examples for exact dola-seed-2-1-turbo-260628 accept text and image input, return output_text, show thinking control and tool requests. Current embedded page content was also retrieved directly.

sources.title: Video understanding
sources.evidence: Indexed official documentation provides video-understanding and equivalent timestamped image-frame request examples explicitly using dola-seed-2-1-turbo-260628. This is exact-variant evidence for video input.

sources.title: Service Specific Terms — ModelArk and Model Services
sources.evidence: Read current embedded MDContent. Defines BytePlus Model Services as API services developed or owned by BytePlus or affiliates and grants a limited, revocable, non-transferable service license. Supports proprietary service classification; it is not a weight-distribution license.

sources.title: Seed2.1 official launch (Chinese)
sources.evidence: Reopened and directly retrieved October 27. The June 23 Chinese announcement explicitly offers Pro and Turbo in TRAE and Ark. It describes capabilities and training iteration, not numeric parameter counts or a size-bearing base relationship.

sources.title: ByteDance Seed current model directory
sources.evidence: Read October 27. The official Seed2.1 entry independently states that Pro and Turbo are models of different sizes. It provides neither numerical counts nor a publicly sized predecessor mapping. Turbo is not treated as a serving-only duplicate based on its speed positioning.

sources.title: Seed2.1 comparison article - same-parameter wording lead
sources.evidence: Opened October 27 solely to resolve a Chinese lineage search lead. The byline is a community author, not the Seed team. Its parameter-alignment wording refers to context-window and pricing specifications, not identical learned weights or a numeric parameter count. Official Seed documentation instead identifies different model sizes; no technical catalog value is based on this article.

sources.title: Seed2.1 comparison post - distillation and quantization lead
sources.evidence: Opened October 27 as a fresh Chinese search lead. It asserts expert reduction, distillation and INT4 quantization for Turbo without a count-bearing ByteDance source; its own comparison table leaves total and activated counts unpublished. The checked official release/card does not establish these architectural claims. Neither topology nor size is inferred from this secondary post.

name.note: Official typography is Seed2.1 Turbo; catalog spacing is a faithful display normalization.

developer.note: Model card is authored by ByteDance Seed; provider row explicitly identifies ByteDance.

family.note: Explicitly belongs to the Seed family and Seed2.1 generation.

release_date.note: Initial Seed2.1 release introducing Turbo and Pro. The 260628 API identifier and later BytePlus/plan rollout are revision or availability dates, not the initial release date.

open_weights.note: Documented release is a hosted proprietary model service. Official release/card provides API access and no distributed Turbo checkpoint or open-weight license.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted ByteDance/BytePlus model service under limited service terms, not an SPDX license or claim that a checkpoint license was published.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 original-source, full-card, later-comparison and English/Chinese exact-name count/lineage searches found no developer-published nominal total or publicly sized base relationship. Official sources explicitly distinguish Pro and Turbo as different sizes. Community same-parameter wording concerns context settings; uncorroborated distillation claims supply no count. Null reflects missing supported nominal evidence, not an exact-tensor-census requirement.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 active/activated searches and separate exact Turbo table checks found no active count or counting convention. The full card and later provider comparisons contain benchmark scores, token limits and capabilities, not activated-parameter columns. Speed, pricing and unsupported architecture claims do not establish an active count; no equality with total is inferred.

architecture.note: No exact Turbo neural architecture disclosure located in the model card or later official sources, including targeted training/interpretability searches. Model-card architecture text concerns software or the Deep Think agent pipeline, not production neural layers.

context_window.note: Nominal normalization of the documented 256K/256k, not verification of an exact 256000-token ceiling. Current Turbo remains the 260628 revision; newer 1024k Pro/Lite rows are distinct. No exact integer is documented in the inspected Turbo sources.

modalities.note: Exact Turbo examples establish text/image/video input and text output. The current capability table explicitly marks audio understanding No, so no audio is added.

reasoning.note: Exact Turbo capability table marks deep reasoning Yes and official examples expose thinking control.

tool_call.note: Current exact Turbo tables explicitly confirm function calling and tool use; BytePlus also marks MCP support Yes.

description.note: Replaces baseline comparative speed and latency positioning with documented capabilities.

patch.description: ByteDance Seed 2.1 model for multimodal reasoning, coding, and tool calling.
patch.notes: Context is documented as nominal 256K; 256000 is a display normalization, not an independently documented exact token ceiling. Current first-party Turbo specifications refer to doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628 / dola-seed-2-1-turbo-260628. The 2026-06-23 date is the initial Seed2.1 launch; 260628 identifies the later API revision. Nominal total and active counts remain undisclosed. ByteDance identifies Pro and Turbo as different-sized models; no publicly sized base relationship is established. Neural architecture remains undisclosed. Audio understanding is explicitly unsupported in the current BytePlus Turbo table.
